title: Legal Secretary
description:
Legal Secretary

When registering to this job board you will be redirected to the online application form. Please ensure that this is completed in full in order that your application can be reviewed.

At Slater Heelis, we pride ourselves on delivering exceptional legal services while maintaining a supportive, collaborative, and people-focused culture. We are seeking an experienced and proactive Legal Secretary to provide high-quality administrative and secretarial support to our lawyers.

This is an excellent opportunity for a professional legal secretary who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys being a key part of a successful litigation team.

The Role

Working closely with Partners, Associates and other fee earners within our Commercial Litigation department, you will play a vital role in ensuring the smooth day-to-day operation of the team.

Key responsibilities will include:

Audio and copy typing of legal documents, correspondence and court forms
Managing diaries, appointments and meetings
Opening, maintaining and closing client files
Preparing and submitting documents to the courts and other parties
Handling client enquiries professionally via telephone and email
Assisting with billing, expenses and file management
Monitoring deadlines and ensuring compliance with court timetables
Organising meetings, conference calls and travel arrangements where required
Providing general administrative support to the wider litigation team

About You

The successful candidate will have:

Previous experience as a Legal Secretary, ideally within litigation or dispute resolution
Excellent typing and document production skills
Strong organisational and time management abilities
Exceptional attention to detail
Experience using case management systems and Microsoft Office applications
Strong communication and interpersonal skills
The ability to manage multiple priorities and work to tight deadlines
A proactive, positive and team-oriented approach

Experience within Commercial Litigation or broader Litigation departments would be advantageous, although candidates from other legal practice areas with transferable skills will also be considered.

What We Offer

At Slater Heelis, we recognise that our people are our greatest asset. We offer:

Competitive salary
Generous holiday allowance
Pension scheme
Health and wellbeing support
Ongoing training and development opportunities
A supportive and inclusive working environment
Career progression within a growing and ambitious firm

Apply Now

If you are an organised and experienced Legal Secretary looking to join a highly regarded Commercial Litigation team, we would love to hear from you.

Slater Heelis is committed to promoting equality, diversity and inclusion and welcomes applications from all suitably qualified candidates.

title: Paralegal
description:
Portfolio are proud to exclusively represent our client in their search for a Paralegal. This is an amazing opportunity for a Law graduate or experienced Paralegal to join the exsisting Litigation team, providing integral support in the litigation stage of Employment tribunals. You will be dealing with clients over phone and email, drafing of documents and legal admin, creating bundles and taking minutes in meetings. You will need to be organised and have good time management in a fast paced department. In return you will have amazing support and guidance, encouraging progression withing the business. If you have recently graduated with an LLb and are looking for your first role within Employment Law, please apply today and we'll be in touch!

Job Purpose
You will be working within a well established Legal department based in Manchester city centre, assisting the Litigation Executives prepare for Employment Tribunals.

Job Overview
We are looking for a bright, confident and enthusiastic team member who can assist Litigation Executives with telephone and email communications, drafting and legal administration. The successful candidate will gain exposure to commercial legal practice, working in a dynamic team covering Employment Law. A focus on remarkable client service and care is key for this role. The ideal candidate will have experience putting into practice their excellent communication skills (face-to-face, telephone, written text and email).

The position also presents a fantastic opportunity for anyone who has a genuine interest in Employment Law and wants to progress and build a career within a commercially focused company.

Day-to-Day Responsibilities
Handling client enquiries.
Supporting Litigation Executives with their varied caseloads, assisting with applications, documents and bundles.
Assisting the firm in discharging its regulatory obligations, primarily in respect of Client Care.
Working proactively to assist in the creation and maintenance of files, system notes, minutes and diaries.
Collaborating with the team furthering continually improving customer experience.

What you Bring to the Team
A sound academic background - LLb with Employment law as a module or Elective
Experience in a customer focused environment and track record of excellent performance
A positive team ethic and business development focus
Excellent written and oral communication skills
